scope: Only the two supplementary Markdown files edited; no tables, numbers, intervals, main source, figures, statistics, server or Baidu access. Renderer retains previous Table 4C KeepTogether.

changes.before: The present analysis uses retained, checksum-identified processed tables and model inputs. Their exact historical ClinVar content-release date is unverified: a retained raw-file copy contains 2026 LastEvaluated records, but its relationship to the earlier processed tables has not been independently established. We therefore do not assign 31 March 2024, or a replacement 2026 date, to the frozen benchmark. Checksums and verified row identities identify the evaluated inputs; they do not establish temporal independence.
changes.after: The present analysis uses retained, checksum-identified processed tables and model inputs; their exact historical ClinVar content-release date is unverified. Checksums and verified row identities identify the frozen evaluated inputs but do not establish temporal independence.
changes.reason: State unverified content-release date and frozen-input scope directly without dated editorial history.

changes.before: Two supplementary fixed operators were used: row-normalized two-hop mean propagation with residual averaging, and two rounds of cosine-softmax-weighted neighbour aggregation with residual averaging. The code runs both under no-gradient computation and has no learned aggregation or attention parameters. The original labels "GraphSAGE-style" and "GAT-style" are replaced by "Fixed mean propagation" and "Fixed cosine-weighted propagation". These are operator controls, not trained GraphSAGE/GAT baselines. The cosine operator includes self-neighbours and softmax weights from the current feature cosine similarity; trained graph models were not evaluated.
changes.after: Two supplementary fixed operators were used. Fixed mean propagation applies row-normalized two-hop mean propagation with residual averaging. Fixed cosine-weighted propagation applies two rounds of cosine-softmax-weighted neighbour aggregation with residual averaging, including self-neighbours and softmax weights from the current feature cosine similarity. Both run under no-gradient computation and have no learned aggregation or attention parameters. These are fixed operator controls, not trained GraphSAGE/GAT baselines; trained graph models were not evaluated.
changes.reason: Direct definitions of both fixed operators; no learned-parameter claim preserved.

changes.before: No explicit distinction between displayed Delta conventions.
changes.after: In Table 4A, Delta denotes FPP minus raw ESM. The Variant rows report the mean of the 1,000 paired variant-bootstrap differences; the Protein-clustered rows report the observed difference on the original test set. Both 95% intervals are the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of the corresponding bootstrap differences.
changes.reason: Archived variant summary uses bootstrap mean; archived protein summary uses observed point estimate; both intervals are percentile intervals.
